name: Mabel Thompson
observable_traits: Always carrying a pouch of cat food
goals: Ensures all stray cats are fed and cared for
boundaries: Does not take stray cats into her home
Refuses to intervene in human conflicts

relationships.description: Oliver is Mabel's favorite and always follows her around

history_notes: Worked at the town clinic for 30 years
Started feeding stray cats after retirement
current_state: Mabel is sitting on the porch, gently tossing food to the neighborhood cats.
facts_they_know: All stray cats in town have names
She once saved a baby raccoon from a storm
beliefs: Cats are happier living outdoors with their own kind
She can communicate with animals through her intuition
factual_errors: Believes she is the only person who knows all cat names, when others recall some
